app_tagline: Edit your Beanconqueror backup right in your browser: beans, brews, grinders and methods.
drop_hint: or drop a Beanconqueror backup (.zip) here
howto_share_body: In Beanconqueror, go to Settings, Transfer data and choose Export, then share the zip with Beans Editor. Install Beans Editor first (Add to Home screen) so it shows up in the share menu.
howto_open_body: Export a backup from Beanconqueror and save it, then tap Open file above or drop the zip on this page.
howto_link_title: Add a bean from a shop page
howto_link_body: On the roaster's product page, share its URL with Beans Editor. Beanconqueror opens its Add Bean screen, filled in and ready to save. While editing a backup, tap Add bean from URL to add it there instead.
howto_finish: When you finish editing, download the backup and import it in Beanconqueror from Settings, Transfer data, Import.
link_backup_only_fields: Beanconqueror doesn't take a buy date, best before date or freezing details from a shared URL. To add them, open a backup and use Add bean from URL there.
bean_delete_blocked: This bean can't be deleted because brews use it (brews: {count}). Archive it instead to hide it from lists.
bean_delete_confirm: Delete this bean? This can't be undone once you download the backup.
error_percentage: Origin percentages add up to more than 100
draft_restored: Restored the backup you were editing.
draft_invalid: The work saved in this browser couldn't be read, possibly after an update.
replace_body: The backup you're editing has changes you haven't downloaded. Opening {file} replaces them.
editor_storage_failed: This browser couldn't keep a copy of your changes. Download the backup before closing the page.
brew_delete_confirm: Delete this brew? This can't be undone once you download the backup.
methods_empty: No methods in this backup. Methods are created in Beanconqueror.
gear_delete_blocked: This can't be deleted because brews use it (brews: {count}). Archive it instead to hide it from lists.
gear_delete_confirm: Delete this? This can't be undone once you download the backup.
not_a_backup: This isn't a Beanconqueror backup. In the app, go to Settings, Transfer data and choose Export to get one.
share_empty: Nothing to open came through the share. Share the backup zip itself, from Beanconqueror (Settings, Transfer data, Export) or from a file manager.
link_title: Add a bean from a URL
link_intro: Paste the roaster's product page. Beans Editor reads it and fills in what it finds, then Beanconqueror opens its Add Bean screen with it.
link_intro_backup: Paste the roaster's product page. Beans Editor reads it and fills in what it finds, then adds the bean to this backup.
link_reading_wait: This can take a few seconds.
link_invalid: That doesn't look like a URL. Paste the full address, starting with https://.
link_dead: This page couldn't be read: the shop says it no longer exists. Check the URL, or fill in the bean by hand.
link_rate_limited: Too many pages read in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
link_unreachable: Couldn't read this page. Check your connection and try again, or fill in the bean by hand.
link_offline: You're offline, so the page can't be read. You can still fill in the bean by hand.
link_review: Check what was found and fix anything that's wrong. Empty fields weren't on the page.
link_opened: Sent to Beanconqueror. Check the bean there and tap Save to add it.
link_not_opened: Beanconqueror didn't open. Make sure it's installed on this device, then try again.
